note: What's new in Seiza, for visitors. Written by hand in plain words, each month with a one-line summary; home/build.mjs adds the commits made after `through` (see home/README.md), so a month can be rewritten here whenever it's worth it.

months.summary: Play comes to Seiza: Fantasy and Band modes, six new worlds, and avatars that move like people.

items.text: Fantasy mode: a sword, katana, naginata, scythe, light saber, bow, and a necromancer's rod that raises undead. Blades really parry, combos chain, and arrows can be dodged.
Six elements for specials, each with its own move and burst: Spectro, Havoc, Aero, Electro, Fusion, and Glacio.
Band mode: a drum kit, a taiko, keys, a kulintang's row of gongs, acoustic, lead, and bass guitars, a shaker, and light sticks, heard by the whole room.
Play an instrument by tapping it, and everyone sees the note light up. In VR, play with your hands.
Hold chords on the keys, pick melodies string by string on the guitars, and strike two drums at once with both hands.
Your record: knockouts, assists, falls, and best combo for every weapon, kept on your device.
Tulay, Seiza's Filipino home: a bahay kubo hall, beach cottages, and coconut palms.
ISCOLab, UP Open University's science communication lab, to walk through, under repair for now, with a kubo across the meadow for sessions.
SeiOU and Seinag: UP Open University's campus, with guides, live rooftop solar, and a permaculture garden tour.
Seisugbo, the Meiji × UP art exhibition with Tala as its guide, and Seizorai, where Ilaw-san explains the microgrid.
Fighters and musicians move their whole body, and no pose sticks after a mode ends.
More natural avatars: softer designer faces and eyes, real hair and clothes, and relaxed arms.
In VR, avatars lean, reach, and step like you, with a comfort vignette and admin tools on your wrist.
The VR wrist menu has every mode: weapons, instruments, light sticks, and, for editors, the switches that turn them on.
A beach, the sea, seasons, falling leaves, and rain with thunder.
English and Japanese everywhere, chat translation and guides included.
Portals between every world, and a way home from each.

months.summary: Seizora and Seilaya open, the sky follows the real weather, and together gestures arrive.

items.text: Seizora, a solar, wind, and battery microgrid for a town in Cebu, with live readings and an El Niño scenario.
Seilaya, a safe spaces lab for learning about gender, safety, and respect.
A sky that follows the time and weather in the Philippines, and a room's own time and weather, set by its editors.
Handshakes, high fives, hugs, and a slow dance, which only happen when both people say yes.
VR body tracking and a wrist menu. You can also see your own body in first person.
Avaturn avatars, made ready in your browser, and a built-in avatar designer with expressions and lip sync.
The rooms came alive: a pond you can wade into, light switches, clocks, sliding shoji, a campsite, and a tent to sleep in.
Kneel in seiza long enough and your avatar starts to doze off (you can turn this off for meetings).
Safer uploads and a sturdier room server.
Gestures, with a practice mode, and postures: sitting, and kneeling in seiza.
Boards to write on, screens to present on, an outdoor garden, and a custom sky.
Touch controls for phones, and a limit on how many people a room holds.
The first Seiza: multiplayer rooms you host on your own account, VRM avatars, voice, and editing the world together.
